note: What a server sends to carry a client's view from one place to another. The header names the champion of the player it is sent to.

revisions.note: A client always moves its view from where it stands to toX, toY and toZ over travelTime; how, fromX, fromY and fromZ have no effect.

fields.name: travelTime
